item.title: US Treasury proposes GENIUS Act rule on stablecoin issuance eligibility; violations carry up to $1M fine and 5-year prison term.
Citi confirms Bitcoin custody for institutional clients under new Custody+ platform, with launch expected before year-end 2026.
SEC plans to finalize Regulation Crypto Assets exemption rule as CLARITY Act stalls ahead of September 15 Senate cloture vote.
SEC and CFTC release joint interpretation on federal securities law for crypto assets, including custody standards for advisers.
EU Transfer of Funds Regulation drops Travel Rule threshold to zero for all crypto transfers effective August 3.
Cboe BZX files with SEC for approval to list first 3x leveraged Bitcoin and Ether ETFs in the United States.
Coldcard firmware exploit drained $116M in Bitcoin from 5,200-plus addresses; flaw existed in devices manufactured since March 2021.
BNY adds staking to its digital asset custody platform, expanding services for institutional crypto clients.
Visa, Mastercard, and BlackRock join 140-firm Open USD consortium backing OUSD stablecoin launch on Solana.
EU MiCA full compliance and DAC8 mandatory crypto tax reporting entered into force July 1 across all member states.
Cecabank, a Spanish wholesale custodian, goes live with crypto custody services via Bit2Me exchange partnership.
Crypto exploits totaled $1.32B across 276 incidents in H1 2026, with Coldcard ranking as the year's third-largest loss.
OCC opens rulemaking on GENIUS Act federal charter requirements; stablecoin licensing deadline set for January 18, 2027.
